E_original: mean of three normalized native target/source response magnitudes
route_mask: engine route_mask64 stores 1-E before floor; packed route mask is same un-floored support
P_shifted: toroidal roll of P_original by (32,32), only SHIFT
P_correction: actual correction allocation for CORR/SHIFT; absent for GLOBAL, which uses an unmasked global residual
mask_source: native prompt-response probes; no official mask
